caption:
SpaceX's AI unit made $7.56 billion last quarter, more than Starlink's roughly $5.25 billion, and beat analyst estimates.
It includes Grok, Cursor and a cloud business that rents out computing power.
SpaceX posted $4.4 billion in net income on $14.6 billion in revenue.

Is SpaceX now an AI company?

Follow @neurafeed.ai for daily AI news.

Source: Reuters · Photo: SpaceX

slides.headline: Elon Musk's AI business just made *more money than Starlink*

slides.heading: *$7.56 billion* in three months
paras: SpaceX's AI unit, now called Super Intelligence, brought in $7.56 billion last quarter, beating the roughly $6.3 billion analysts expected.

paras.t: Starlink's connectivity business made about $5.25 billion.

slides.heading: Grok, Cursor and *rented chips*
paras: The unit includes the Grok chatbot, the Cursor coding tool SpaceX bought in August, and a cloud business that rents out computing power.
Reuters says those customers include Anthropic, Google and Reflection AI.

slides.heading: A *$4.4 billion* profit
paras: Total revenue hit $14.6 billion, up 161% from a year earlier, and SpaceX posted $4.4 billion in net income.
It also spent $19.6 billion in the quarter, most of it on AI.

slides.hook: Musk's rocket company now earns most of its money from AI. Follow to see where it goes next.
